qa_pair.question: Check the live Tenda router overview and report how many WAN ports are configured in router_wan_ports.
Using tenda_query_readonly_sql, confirm whether reading the restricted `settings` table is blocked (`blocked`) or allowed (`allowed`).
Using tenda_list_devices with category="tv", inspect the Smart TV devices and check whether QoS speed limits are returned in KB/s (`KB/s`) or Mbps (`Mbps`).
Run tenda_get_quota_forecast in JSON format and report the default billing renewal day integer (`renewalDay`) when no custom billing day is overridden.
Using tenda_diagnose_anomalies_and_outages, check the SQLite telemetry integrity section and report the field name that counts 48-hour raw router samples.

Query the `ai_device_profiles` schema via tenda_query_readonly_sql (`SELECT * FROM ai_device_profiles LIMIT 1`) or tool schema summary and state the column name used to store the Arabic explanation rationale.
Attempt a read-only SQL query joining `devices` and `dhcp_reservations` to count how many static DHCP reservations currently have a valid IPv4 address, returning the integer count.
Inspect the `tenda_set_device_control` tool schema and report the maximum allowed integer value for `download_limit_kbs`.
Using `tenda_get_device_detail` in JSON mode on an existing device, report the property path under `last24h` that distinguishes LAN-only Frigate/NAS transfers from internet WAN traffic.
Check the valid enum options for `wan_port` in `tenda_set_device_control` besides `WAN1` and `WAN2` that restores automatic Dual-WAN load balancing.
